questions.q: What is the actual security fix in this lesson, as distinct from the investigation in Lessons 11-15?
options: Rewriting the compliance audit's report to show 19 instead of 14
Revoking the 5 accounts' direct, individually-assigned admin access to the OT/SCADA segment, under proper change control
Deleting the Python automation since it caused the discrepancy
Disabling the OT-SCADA-Admins group entirely
questions.explain: Explaining the gap didn't remove any access -- the fix is actually revoking the 5 stale, direct grants, done through a ticketed change-control process given the sensitivity of the OT/SCADA segment.

questions.q: Why does the revocation go through Hartwell's change-management process with a scheduled maintenance window, rather than being applied immediately in the moment it's found?
options: Because change tickets are required for every Python script change
Because removing standing admin access from an OT boundary, even stale access, is itself a change that could affect operations if done carelessly
Because Howard Okonjo must personally approve every IAM call
Because AWS requires a 30-day waiting period to detach policies
questions.explain: Even removing access that shouldn't exist is a production change on a sensitive OT segment, so it goes through review and a scheduled window rather than being applied ad hoc.

questions.q: Which command removes a policy attached directly to an AWS IAM user, rather than inherited through a group?
options: aws iam remove-user-from-group
aws iam detach-user-policy --user-name <username> --policy-arn <arn>
aws iam delete-group
aws iam create-access-key
questions.explain: detach-user-policy removes a policy attached straight to a user -- exactly the direct-assignment mechanism behind the 5 stale accounts, distinct from group membership.

questions.q: After the revocation, what two things does Mara re-run to validate the fix?
options: The original compliance audit's checklist, twice
A corrected manual review checking both group membership and direct assignment, and the Python automation
Only the Python automation, a second time
A new penetration test of the entire network
questions.explain: Validation means re-measuring the same way the discrepancy was found -- Mara re-runs a corrected manual review (now checking both sources) and the automation, rather than assuming the fix worked.

questions.q: What result actually proves the fix worked, according to this lesson?
options: The ticket was marked "closed" in the change-management system
Both the corrected manual review and the automation now report the same number -- 14, with zero direct assignments remaining -- which is agreement that didn't exist before the fix
Howard Okonjo verbally confirmed it was fixed
The audit team apologized for their original method
questions.explain: The proof isn't the revocation alone -- it's that two independently run methods, which previously disagreed (14 vs. 19), now agree (14 and 14) for the first time.
